rationale: The report is highly structured and complete, but it is riddled with fabrications. It invents causes (bearing wear), specific actions (monitoring performance), and extensive follow-up recommendations not found in the input. It also fails to use the provided registry IDs and presents the information as complete without flagging any missing details.
